name: Bright
prompt: Keep imagery open, hopeful, colorful, and emotionally light.

name: Balanced
prompt: Mix shadow and optimism without letting either dominate.

name: Dark
prompt: Use nocturnal imagery, tension, minor-key emotional language, and serious atmosphere.

name: Very Dark
prompt: Build an oppressive late-night world of threat, isolation, cold detail, and psychological pressure.

name: Dark to Triumphant
prompt: Start in danger and uncertainty, then turn darkness into controlled victory by the final section.

name: Sunlit
prompt: Use open major-colour harmony bright timbres vivid daylight imagery generous space and an uplifting ending.

name: Warm Twilight
prompt: Blend golden warmth with gentle evening melancholy and finish in reflective calm rather than despair.

name: Neutral
prompt: Keep harmony imagery and production emotionally centred without pushing strongly bright or dark.

name: Moody
prompt: Use overcast tension intimate shadows restrained minor colour and unresolved emotional undercurrents.

name: Noir
prompt: Build a smoky late-night world of moral ambiguity rain neon suspicion and tightly controlled menace.

name: Bleak
prompt: Use cold sparse imagery emotional exhaustion narrow hope and an ending that remains painfully unresolved.

name: Horror
prompt: Create dread through threatening detail dissonant atmosphere isolation sudden shocks and a genuinely frightening climax.

name: Abyssal
prompt: Push overwhelming darkness with crushing isolation hostile space and almost no emotional light until the final note.

name: Dark with Hope
prompt: Begin in shadow and pressure but reveal a believable thread of warmth resilience or release by the ending.

name: Bright to Dark
prompt: Open colourful and safe then remove warmth section by section until the final passage feels ominous and changed.
